def translit_script(tok):
    out = []
    for ch in tok:
        if ch in CY_MAP:
            out.append(CY_MAP[ch])
        elif ch in AR_MAP:
            out.append(AR_MAP[ch])
        elif ch.isalnum():
            out.append(ch)
    return "".join(out)


def merge_script_tokens(toks):
    out = []
    i = 0
    while i < len(toks):
        if toks[i] in ("عبد", "نصر") and i + 1 < len(toks):
            out.append(toks[i] + " " + toks[i + 1])
            i += 2
        else:
            out.append(toks[i])
            i += 1
    return out


class ScriptLex(object):
    """script token -> latin spelling, learnt from the watchlist itself."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.m = {}

    @staticmethod
    def _latin_units(pn):
        """Group a latin name the same way script names group (abd X)."""
        toks = pn.split()
        out = []
        i = 0
        while i < len(toks):
            t = fold(toks[i]).strip("-")
            if (t in COMPOUND_HEADS or (t.startswith("abd") and len(t) <= 5)) \
                    and i + 1 < len(toks):
                j = i + 1
                if fold(toks[j]).strip("-") in ARTICLES and j + 1 < len(toks):
                    j += 1
                out.append(" ".join(toks[i:j + 1]))
                i = j + 1
                continue
            if t == "nasr" and i + 1 < len(toks):
                out.append(" ".join(toks[i:i + 2]))
                i += 2
                continue
            out.append(toks[i])
            i += 1
        return out

    def learn(self, entries):
        votes = defaultdict(lambda: defaultdict(int))
        for e in entries:
            sn = e.get("script_name")
            pn = e.get("primary_name")
            if not sn or not pn or pn == sn or is_script(pn):
                continue
            a = self._latin_units(pn)
            b = merge_script_tokens(sn.split())
            if len(a) != len(b):
                continue
            for x, y in zip(b, a):
                votes[x][y.lower()] += 1
        for k, v in votes.items():
            self.m[k] = max(v.items(), key=lambda kv: kv[1])[0]

    def latin(self, script_name):
        """Convert a whole script name into a latin name string."""
        toks = merge_script_tokens(script_name.split())
        out = []
        for t in toks:
            if t in self.m:
                out.append(self.m[t])
            elif " " in t:
                parts = t.split()
                head = parts[0]
                rest = " ".join(parts[1:])
                if head == "عبد":
                    tail = self.m.get(rest) or translit_script(rest)
                    out.append("abdul " + tail)
                elif head == "نصر":
                    out.append("nasrallah")
                else:
                    out.append(translit_script(t.replace(" ", "")))
            else:
                # feminine cyrillic forms of a known masculine surname
                done = False
                if is_cyrillic(t) and t.endswith("а") and t[:-1] in self.m:
                    out.append(self.m[t[:-1]] + "a")
                    done = True
                if not done:
                    out.append(translit_script(t))
        return " ".join(out)

def _demote(key):
    """Turn a key into its non word-initial form (first vowel class -> '.')."""
    for i, ch in enumerate(key):
        if ch in "AU":
            return key[:i] + "." + key[i + 1:]
    return key


def glue(ka, kb, cap=240):
    """Keys for two tokens written as one word (Smith Jones/Smith-Jones)."""
    out = set()
    for a in ka:
        if "|" in a:
            continue
        for b in kb:
            if "|" in b:
                continue
            out.add(a + _demote(b))
            if len(out) >= cap:
                return out
    return out


def _bipartite(cs, es):
    """Maximum matching size between two lists of key-sets (tiny lists)."""
    n, m = len(cs), len(es)
    if not n or not m:
        return 0
    adj = [[j for j in range(m) if cs[i] & es[j]] for i in range(n)]
    matchR = [-1] * m

    def try_k(i, seen):
        for j in adj[i]:
            if seen[j]:
                continue
            seen[j] = True
            if matchR[j] == -1 or try_k(matchR[j], seen):
                matchR[j] = i
                return True
        return False

    cnt = 0
    for i in range(n):
        if try_k(i, [False] * m):
            cnt += 1
    return cnt


def _merge_variants(keysets, raws):
    """Yield alternative groupings where two tokens are glued together."""
    yield keysets
    n = len(keysets)
    if n < 2 or n > 4:
        return
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(n):
            if i == j:
                continue
            glued = set()
            for a in keysets[i]:
                for b in keysets[j]:
                    if "|" in a or "|" in b:
                        continue
                    glued.add(a + b)
                    if len(glued) > 200:
                        break
            if not glued:
                continue
            rest = [keysets[k] for k in range(n) if k not in (i, j)]
            yield rest + [glued]


def person_match(ctoks, etoks):
    """True when two parsed individual names refer to the same person."""
    ccore = [t.keys for t in ctoks if t.kind == "core"]
    ecore = [t.keys for t in etoks if t.kind == "core"]
    if len(ccore) < 2 or len(ecore) < 2:
        return False
    # patronymic / nasab consistency
    cp = [t.keys for t in ctoks if t.kind == "patro"]
    ep = [t.keys for t in etoks if t.kind == "patro"]
    if cp and ep and not any(a & b for a in cp for b in ep):
        return False
    cn = [t.keys for t in ctoks if t.kind == "nasab"]
    en = [t.keys for t in etoks if t.kind == "nasab"]
    if cn and en and not any(a & b for a in cn for b in en):
        return False
    best = False
    for cv in _merge_variants(ccore, None):
        for ev in _merge_variants(ecore, None):
            m = _bipartite(cv, ev)
            if m < 2:
                continue
            if (len(cv) - m) + (len(ev) - m) <= 1:
                best = True
                break
        if best:
            break
    if not best:
        return False
    return True


def alias_equal(ctoks, etoks):
    """Strict equality used for weak aliases."""
    c = [t.keys for t in ctoks if t.kind in ("core", "nasab", "patro")]
    e = [t.keys for t in etoks if t.kind in ("core", "nasab", "patro")]
    if len(c) != len(e) or not c:
        return False
    return _bipartite(c, e) == len(c)


def org_match(cwords, ewords):
    if not cwords or not ewords:
        return False
    if len(cwords) != len(ewords):
        return False
    return all(a == b for a, b in zip(cwords, ewords))

def parse_dob(s):
    s = (s or "").strip()
    if not s:
        return None
    m = re.match(r"^(\d{4})(?:-(\d{1,2}))?(?:-(\d{1,2}))?$", s)
    if not m:
        m2 = re.match(r"^(\d{4})$", s[:4])
        if not m2:
            return None
        return (s[:4],)
    parts = [m.group(1)]
    if m.group(2):
        parts.append("%02d" % int(m.group(2)))
    if m.group(3):
        parts.append("%02d" % int(m.group(3)))
    return tuple(parts)


def dob_compatible(c, e):
    """(compatible, corroborated)"""
    if not c or not e:
        return True, False
    n = min(len(c), len(e))
    for i in range(n):
        if c[i] != e[i]:
            return False, False
    return True, True

class Form(object):
    __slots__ = ("toks", "words", "strong")

    def __init__(self, toks, words, strong):
        self.toks = toks
        self.words = words
        self.strong = strong


class Entry(object):
    __slots__ = ("uid", "type", "dob", "forms", "weak", "ids", "weakforms")

    def __init__(self, uid, typ, dob):
        self.uid = uid
        self.type = typ
        self.dob = dob
        self.forms = []
        self.weak = []
        self.weakforms = []
        self.ids = []


def build_entries(raw, lex):
    entries = []
    for e in raw:
        typ = e.get("type") or "individual"
        ent = Entry(e["uid"], typ, parse_dob(e.get("dob")))
        names = []
        pn = e.get("primary_name") or ""
        sn = e.get("script_name") or ""
        if pn:
            names.append(pn)
        if sn:
            names.append(lex.latin(sn))
        for a in e.get("aliases") or []:
            nm = a.get("name") or ""
            if not nm:
                continue
            if is_script(nm):
                nm = lex.latin(nm)
            if (a.get("strength") or "strong").lower() == "weak":
                ent.weak.append(nm)
            else:
                names.append(nm)
        seen = set()
        for nm in names:
            if is_script(nm):
                nm = lex.latin(nm)
            key = fold(nm)
            if key in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(key)
            if typ == "individual":
                ent.forms.append(Form(parse_person(nm), None, True))
            else:
                ent.forms.append(Form(None, parse_org(nm, typ == "vessel"),
                                      True))
        ent.weakforms = [parse_person(n) if typ == "individual" else None
                         for n in ent.weak]
        for i in e.get("ids") or []:
            t = (i.get("type") or "").strip().lower()
            num = re.sub(r"[^A-Z0-9]", "", (i.get("number") or "").upper())
            if num:
                ent.ids.append((t, num))
        entries.append(ent)
    return entries


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# main screening
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

def build_index(entries):
    idx = defaultdict(set)
    for ent in entries:
        for f in ent.forms:
            if f.toks is not None:
                units = []
                for t in f.toks:
                    if t.kind in ("core", "nasab"):
                        units.append(t.keys)
                allk = set()
                for u in units:
                    allk |= u
                # glued pairs (hyphenated surnames written apart)
                core = [t.keys for t in f.toks if t.kind == "core"]
                if 2 <= len(core) <= 4:
                    for i in range(len(core)):
                        for j in range(len(core)):
                            if i == j:
                                continue
                            cnt = 0
                            for a in core[i]:
                                for b in core[j]:
                                    if "|" in a or "|" in b:
                                        continue
                                    allk.add(a + b)
                                    cnt += 1
                                    if cnt > 120:
                                        break
                                if cnt > 120:
                                    break
                for k in allk:
                    idx[k].add(ent.uid)
            else:
                for w in f.words:
                    idx["W:" + w].add(ent.uid)
    return idx


def weak_index(entries):
    idx = defaultdict(set)
    for ent in entries:
        for ftoks in ent.weakforms:
            if not ftoks:
                continue
            for t in ftoks:
                for k in t.keys:
                    idx[k].add(ent.uid)
    return idx


def id_index(entries):
    idx = defaultdict(set)
    for ent in entries:
        for t, num in ent.ids:
            idx[(t, num)].add(ent.uid)
            idx[(None, num)].add(ent.uid)
    return idx


def screen(customers, entries, lex):
    by_uid = {e.uid: e for e in entries}
    idx = build_index(entries)
    widx = weak_index(entries)
    iidx = id_index(entries)
    results = []
    for c in customers:
        cid = c.get("customer_id") or ""
        name = (c.get("full_name") or "").strip()
        typ = (c.get("type") or "individual").strip().lower() or "individual"
        dob = parse_dob(c.get("dob"))
        idt = (c.get("id_type") or "").strip().lower()
        idn = re.sub(r"[^A-Z0-9]", "", (c.get("id_number") or "").upper())
        decision = "NO_MATCH"
        uid = ""
        # ---- rule 1: identifiers ------------------------------------
        if idn:
            hits = iidx.get((idt, idn)) if idt else iidx.get((None, idn))
            if hits:
                uid = sorted(hits)[0]
                results.append((cid, "MATCH", uid))
                continue
        # ---- rule 2/5: names ----------------------------------------
        if is_script(name):
            name = lex.latin(name)
        cands = set()
        if typ == "individual":
            ctoks = parse_person(name)
            units = [t.keys for t in ctoks if t.kind in ("core", "nasab")]
            core = [t.keys for t in ctoks if t.kind == "core"]
            keysets = list(units)
            if 2 <= len(core) <= 4:
                glued = set()
                for i in range(len(core)):
                    for j in range(len(core)):
                        if i == j:
                            continue
                        cnt = 0
                        for a in core[i]:
                            for b in core[j]:
                                if "|" in a or "|" in b:
                                    continue
                                glued.add(a + b)
                                cnt += 1
                                if cnt > 120:
                                    break
                            if cnt > 120:
                                break
                if glued:
                    keysets.append(glued)
            hit = defaultdict(int)
            for ks in keysets:
                seen = set()
                for k in ks:
                    for u in idx.get(k, ()):
                        seen.add(u)
                for u in seen:
                    hit[u] += 1
            cands = {u for u, n in hit.items() if n >= 2}
        else:
            words = parse_org(name, typ == "vessel")
            if words:
                sets = [idx.get("W:" + w, set()) for w in words]
                cands = set.intersection(*sets) if sets else set()
        # evaluate candidates
        strong_hits = []
        for u in cands:
            ent = by_uid[u]
            if ent.type != typ:
                continue
            ok = False
            for f in ent.forms:
                if typ == "individual":
                    if person_match(ctoks, f.toks):
                        ok = True
                        break
                else:
                    if org_match(words, f.words):
                        ok = True
                        break
            if not ok:
                continue
            comp, corr = dob_compatible(dob, ent.dob)
            if not comp:
                continue
            strong_hits.append((0 if corr else 1, u))
        # ---- rule 3: weak aliases -----------------------------------
        if not strong_hits and typ == "individual" and dob and len(dob) == 3:
            wc = set()
            hit = defaultdict(int)
            for t in ctoks:
                if t.kind not in ("core", "nasab"):
                    continue
                seen = set()
                for k in t.keys:
                    for u in widx.get(k, ()):
                        seen.add(u)
                for u in seen:
                    hit[u] += 1
            for u, n in hit.items():
                ent = by_uid[u]
                if ent.type != typ or not ent.dob or len(ent.dob) != 3:
                    continue
                if ent.dob != dob:
                    continue
                for wf in ent.weakforms:
                    if wf and alias_equal(ctoks, wf):
                        strong_hits.append((0, u))
                        break
        if strong_hits:
            strong_hits.sort(key=lambda x: (x[0], x[1]))
            decision = "MATCH"
            uid = strong_hits[0][1]
        results.append((cid, decision, uid))
    return results


def main(argv=None):
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--watchlist", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--customers", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--out", required=True)
    args = ap.parse_args(argv)

    with open(args.watchlist, "r", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        raw = json.load(fh)
    lex = ScriptLex()
    lex.learn(raw)
    entries = build_entries(raw, lex)
    with open(args.customers, "r", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        customers = list(csv.DictReader(fh))
    rows = screen(customers, entries, lex)
    with open(args.out, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as fh:
        w = csv.writer(fh)
        w.writerow(["customer_id", "decision", "matched_uid"])
        for r in rows:
            w.writerow(r)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Randomised convention-stacking stress test.

Rewrites watchlist names with random combinations of romanisation
conventions, name-order changes, particle/nasab/patronymic edits and
entity/vessel suffix swaps, then checks the engine still finds the entry.
"""
import sys, json, re, random, collections
sys.path.insert(0, '/app')
import screen as S

raw = json.load(open('/app/watchlist.json'))
lex = S.ScriptLex(); lex.learn(raw)
entries = S.build_entries(raw, lex)
by = {e.uid: e for e in entries}

R = random.Random(int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 12345)

# spelling conventions applied per token -------------------------------------
SPELL = [
    ('kh', ['h', 'ch', 'kh', 'k']),
    ('sh', ['sh', 'sch', 'ch', 'sz', 'sj', 's', 'sy']),
    ('ch', ['ch', 'tsch', 'tch', 'cz', 'c']),
    ('zh', ['zh', 'j', 'sch', 'z', 'g']),
    ('j', ['j', 'dj', 'dsch', 'g', 'dzh']),
    ('q', ['q', 'k', 'gh', 'c']),
    ('ts', ['ts', 'tz', 'z', 'c']),
    ('v', ['v', 'w', 'ff']),
    ('ou', ['ou', 'u', 'oo', 'o']),
    ('oo', ['oo', 'u', 'ou']),
    ('ee', ['ee', 'i', 'e', 'ie']),
    ('ay', ['ay', 'ai', 'ey', 'ei']),
    ('ei', ['ei', 'ai', 'ay', 'ey']),
    ('y', ['y', 'i', 'j']),
    ('ya', ['ya', 'ja', 'ia']),
    ('yu', ['yu', 'ju', 'iu']),
    ('ie', ['ie', 'i', 'ee']),
    ('ph', ['ph', 'f']),
    ('ck', ['ck', 'k']),
    ('aa', ['aa', 'a']),
    ('ss', ['ss', 's']),
    ('gh', ['gh', 'g', 'q']),
]
VOWEL_SWAP = [('a', 'e'), ('e', 'a'), ('i', 'e'), ('e', 'i'), ('o', 'u'),
              ('u', 'o'), ('i', 'ee'), ('u', 'ou'), ('a', 'ah')]


def respell(tok, p=0.5):
    t = tok
    for src, opts in SPELL:
        if src in t and R.random() < p:
            t = t.replace(src, R.choice(opts), 1)
    if R.random() < 0.4:                    # double a consonant
        i = R.randrange(1, max(2, len(t) - 1))
        if t[i] in 'bcdfgklmnprstz':
            t = t[:i + 1] + t[i] + t[i + 1:]
    if R.random() < 0.35:                   # swap a vowel
        a, b = R.choice(VOWEL_SWAP)
        idx = t.find(a, 1)
        if idx > 0:
            t = t[:idx] + b + t[idx + 1:]
    if R.random() < 0.3 and t[-1] in 'aeiou':   # trailing h / e
        t = t + R.choice(['h', 'e', ''])
    return t


def art_variant(tok):
    """al-Douri -> Al Douri / ad-Douri / Douri / AlDouri"""
    if not re.match(r'^al[- ]?', tok, re.I):
        return tok
    rest = re.sub(r'^al[- ]?', '', tok, flags=re.I)
    if not rest:
        return tok
    sun = rest[0].lower()
    forms = ['al-' + rest, 'Al ' + rest, 'Al' + rest, rest, 'el-' + rest,
             'El' + rest, 'ul-' + rest]
    if sun in 'tdnrszl':
        forms += ['a%s-%s' % (sun, rest), 'A%s%s' % (sun, rest)]
    if sun == 's':
        forms += ['ash-' + rest, 'As' + rest]
    return R.choice(forms)


def person_variant(e, latin):
    toks = latin.split()
    # split off nasab
    out = []
    i = 0
    nasab = None
    while i < len(toks):
        t = toks[i]
        if S.fold(t) in ('bin', 'ibn', 'ben') and i + 1 < len(toks):
            nasab = toks[i + 1]
            i += 2
            continue
        out.append(t)
        i += 1
    core = []
    patro = None
    for t in out:
        if S.PATRO_STRONG.match(S.fold(t)) and len(t) > 6:
            patro = t
        else:
            core.append(t)
    core = [art_variant(t) for t in core]
    core = [respell(t) if R.random() < 0.85 else t for t in core]
    if nasab is not None and R.random() < 0.5:
        nasab = respell(nasab)
    parts = list(core)
    if nasab and R.random() < 0.6:
        marker = R.choice(['bin', 'ibn', 'ben', 'b.'])
        parts = [parts[0], marker, nasab] + parts[1:]
    if patro and R.random() < 0.6:
        parts = [parts[0], respell(patro)] + parts[1:]
    # name order
    mode = R.random()
    if mode < 0.2 and len(parts) >= 2:
        parts = [parts[-1] + ','] + parts[:-1]
    elif mode < 0.35 and len(parts) >= 2:
        parts = [parts[-1]] + parts[:-1]
    if R.random() < 0.15:
        parts.insert(1, R.choice(['A.', 'M.', 'J.']))
    return ' '.join(parts)


LEGAL_FORMS = ['LLC', 'L.L.C.', 'Limited Liability Company', 'Ltd', 'Limited',
               'S.A.', 'SA', 'Sociedad Anonima', 'GmbH', 'G.m.b.H.', 'JSC',
               'Joint Stock Company', 'AO', 'OAO', 'PJSC', 'Co.', 'Co',
               'Company', 'Corp', 'Corporation', 'Inc', 'FZE', 'FZ-LLC',
               'Free Zone Establishment', '']
VPREF = ['M/V ', 'MV ', 'M/T ', 'MT ', 'Vessel ', '', 'M/S ']


def org_variant(e, latin):
    words = S.parse_org(latin, False)
    if not words:
        return latin
    s = ' '.join(words)
    if R.random() < 0.8:
        s = s + ' ' + R.choice(LEGAL_FORMS)
    if R.random() < 0.2:
        s = 'The ' + s
    if R.random() < 0.3:
        s = s.upper()
    if R.random() < 0.2:
        s = s.replace(' ', ', ', 1)
    return s.strip()


def vessel_variant(e, latin):
    words = S.parse_org(latin, True)
    s = ' '.join(words)
    return R.choice(VPREF) + (s.upper() if R.random() < 0.3 else s)


tests = []
for e in raw:
    latin = e['primary_name']
    if S.is_script(latin):
        latin = lex.latin(e['script_name'])
    for _ in range(int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 2):
        if e['type'] == 'individual':
            nm = person_variant(e, latin)
        elif e['type'] == 'vessel':
            nm = vessel_variant(e, latin)
        else:
            nm = org_variant(e, latin)
        dob = e.get('dob') or ''
        if dob and R.random() < 0.3:
            dob = dob[:4] if R.random() < 0.5 else dob[:7]
        tests.append((nm, e['uid'], latin, dob, e['type']))

customers = [{'customer_id': 'S%05d' % i, 'full_name': nm, 'dob': dob,
              'nationality': '', 'id_type': '', 'id_number': '', 'type': t}
             for i, (nm, uid, latin, dob, t) in enumerate(tests)]
rows = S.screen(customers, entries, lex)
ok = collections.Counter()
bad = []
for (nm, uid, latin, dob, t), r in zip(tests, rows):
    good = (r[1] == 'MATCH' and r[2] == uid)
    if not good and r[1] == 'MATCH':
        # twin entry with identical name is acceptable
        o = by[r[2]]
        n1 = sorted(' '.join(sorted(x.raw for x in f.toks)) for f in o.forms
                    if f.toks is not None) if t == 'individual' else None
        if o.dob == by[uid].dob or not dob:
            pass
    ok[(t, good)] += 1
    if not good:
        bad.append((t, nm, latin, uid, r[2], dob))
for t in ('individual', 'entity', 'vessel'):
    g = ok[(t, True)]
    tot = g + ok[(t, False)]
    if tot:
        print(f'{t:12s} {g:5d}/{tot:5d} = {g/tot:.4f}')
print('failures:', len(bad))
for b in bad[:45]:
    print(f'  {b[0][:4]} {b[1]!r} (from {b[2]!r} {b[3]} dob={b[5]}) got={b[4]}')

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Randomised convention-stacking stress test.

Rewrites watchlist names with random combinations of romanisation
conventions, name-order changes, particle/nasab/patronymic edits and
entity/vessel suffix swaps, then checks the engine still finds the entry.
"""
import sys, json, re, random, collections
sys.path.insert(0, '/app')
import screen as S

raw = json.load(open('/app/watchlist.json'))
lex = S.ScriptLex(); lex.learn(raw)
entries = S.build_entries(raw, lex)
by = {e.uid: e for e in entries}

R = random.Random(int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 12345)

# spelling conventions applied per token -------------------------------------
SPELL = [
    ('kh', ['h', 'ch', 'kh', 'k']),
    ('sh', ['sh', 'sch', 'ch', 'sz', 'sj', 's', 'sy']),
    ('ch', ['ch', 'tsch', 'tch', 'cz', 'c']),
    ('zh', ['zh', 'j', 'sch', 'z', 'g']),
    ('j', ['j', 'dj', 'dsch', 'g', 'dzh']),
    ('q', ['q', 'k', 'gh', 'c']),
    ('ts', ['ts', 'tz', 'z', 'c']),
    ('v', ['v', 'w', 'ff']),
    ('ou', ['ou', 'u', 'oo', 'o']),
    ('oo', ['oo', 'u', 'ou']),
    ('ee', ['ee', 'i', 'e', 'ie']),
    ('ay', ['ay', 'ai', 'ey', 'ei']),
    ('ei', ['ei', 'ai', 'ay', 'ey']),
    ('y', ['y', 'i', 'j']),
    ('ya', ['ya', 'ja', 'ia']),
    ('yu', ['yu', 'ju', 'iu']),
    ('ie', ['ie', 'i', 'ee']),
    ('ph', ['ph', 'f']),
    ('ck', ['ck', 'k']),
    ('aa', ['aa', 'a']),
    ('ss', ['ss', 's']),
    ('gh', ['gh', 'g', 'q']),
]
VOWEL_SWAP = [('a', 'e'), ('e', 'a'), ('i', 'e'), ('e', 'i'), ('o', 'u'),
              ('u', 'o'), ('i', 'ee'), ('u', 'ou'), ('a', 'ah')]


def respell(tok, p=0.5):
    t = tok
    for src, opts in SPELL:
        if src in t and R.random() < p:
            t = t.replace(src, R.choice(opts), 1)
    if R.random() < 0.4:                    # double a consonant
        i = R.randrange(1, max(2, len(t) - 1))
        if t[i] in 'bcdfgklmnprstz':
            t = t[:i + 1] + t[i] + t[i + 1:]
    if R.random() < 0.35:                   # swap a vowel
        a, b = R.choice(VOWEL_SWAP)
        idx = t.find(a, 1)
        if idx > 0:
            t = t[:idx] + b + t[idx + 1:]
    if R.random() < 0.3 and t[-1] in 'aeiou':   # trailing h / e
        t = t + R.choice(['h', 'e', ''])
    return t


def art_variant(tok):
    """al-Douri -> Al Douri / ad-Douri / Douri / AlDouri"""
    if not re.match(r'^al[- ]?', tok, re.I):
        return tok
    rest = re.sub(r'^al[- ]?', '', tok, flags=re.I)
    if not rest:
        return tok
    sun = rest[0].lower()
    forms = ['al-' + rest, 'Al ' + rest, 'Al' + rest, rest, 'el-' + rest,
             'El' + rest, 'ul-' + rest]
    if sun in 'tdnrszl':
        forms += ['a%s-%s' % (sun, rest), 'A%s%s' % (sun, rest)]
    if sun == 's':
        forms += ['ash-' + rest, 'As' + rest]
    return R.choice(forms)


def person_variant(e, latin):
    toks = latin.split()
    # split off nasab
    out = []
    i = 0
    nasab = None
    while i < len(toks):
        t = toks[i]
        if S.fold(t) in ('bin', 'ibn', 'ben') and i + 1 < len(toks):
            nasab = toks[i + 1]
            i += 2
            continue
        out.append(t)
        i += 1
    core = []
    patro = None
    for t in out:
        if S.PATRO_STRONG.match(S.fold(t)) and len(t) > 6:
            patro = t
        else:
            core.append(t)
    core = [art_variant(t) for t in core]
    core = [respell(t) if R.random() < 0.85 else t for t in core]
    if nasab is not None and R.random() < 0.5:
        nasab = respell(nasab)
    parts = list(core)
    if nasab and R.random() < 0.6:
        marker = R.choice(['bin', 'ibn', 'ben', 'b.'])
        parts = [parts[0], marker, nasab] + parts[1:]
    if patro and R.random() < 0.6:
        parts = [parts[0], respell(patro)] + parts[1:]
    # name order
    mode = R.random()
    if mode < 0.2 and len(parts) >= 2:
        parts = [parts[-1] + ','] + parts[:-1]
    elif mode < 0.35 and len(parts) >= 2:
        parts = [parts[-1]] + parts[:-1]
    if R.random() < 0.15:
        parts.insert(1, R.choice(['A.', 'M.', 'J.']))
    return ' '.join(parts)


LEGAL_FORMS = ['LLC', 'L.L.C.', 'Limited Liability Company', 'Ltd', 'Limited',
               'S.A.', 'SA', 'Sociedad Anonima', 'GmbH', 'G.m.b.H.', 'JSC',
               'Joint Stock Company', 'AO', 'OAO', 'PJSC', 'Co.', 'Co',
               'Company', 'Corp', 'Corporation', 'Inc', 'FZE', 'FZ-LLC',
               'Free Zone Establishment', '']
VPREF = ['M/V ', 'MV ', 'M/T ', 'MT ', 'Vessel ', '', 'M/S ']


def org_variant(e, latin):
    words = S.parse_org(latin, False)
    if not words:
        return latin
    s = ' '.join(words)
    if R.random() < 0.8:
        s = s + ' ' + R.choice(LEGAL_FORMS)
    if R.random() < 0.2:
        s = 'The ' + s
    if R.random() < 0.3:
        s = s.upper()
    if R.random() < 0.2:
        s = s.replace(' ', ', ', 1)
    return s.strip()


def vessel_variant(e, latin):
    words = S.parse_org(latin, True)
    s = ' '.join(words)
    return R.choice(VPREF) + (s.upper() if R.random() < 0.3 else s)


tests = []
for e in raw:
    latin = e['primary_name']
    if S.is_script(latin):
        latin = lex.latin(e['script_name'])
    for _ in range(int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 2):
        if e['type'] == 'individual':
            nm = person_variant(e, latin)
        elif e['type'] == 'vessel':
            nm = vessel_variant(e, latin)
        else:
            nm = org_variant(e, latin)
        dob = e.get('dob') or ''
        if dob and R.random() < 0.3:
            dob = dob[:4] if R.random() < 0.5 else dob[:7]
        tests.append((nm, e['uid'], latin, dob, e['type']))

customers = [{'customer_id': 'S%05d' % i, 'full_name': nm, 'dob': dob,
              'nationality': '', 'id_type': '', 'id_number': '', 'type': t}
             for i, (nm, uid, latin, dob, t) in enumerate(tests)]
rows = S.screen(customers, entries, lex)
ok = collections.Counter()
bad = []
for (nm, uid, latin, dob, t), r in zip(tests, rows):
    good = (r[1] == 'MATCH' and r[2] == uid)
    if not good and r[1] == 'MATCH':
        # twin entry with identical name is acceptable
        o = by[r[2]]
        n1 = sorted(' '.join(sorted(x.raw for x in f.toks)) for f in o.forms
                    if f.toks is not None) if t == 'individual' else None
        if o.dob == by[uid].dob or not dob:
            pass
    ok[(t, good)] += 1
    if not good:
        bad.append((t, nm, latin, uid, r[2], dob))
for t in ('individual', 'entity', 'vessel'):
    g = ok[(t, True)]
    tot = g + ok[(t, False)]
    if tot:
        print(f'{t:12s} {g:5d}/{tot:5d} = {g/tot:.4f}')
print('failures:', len(bad))
for b in bad[:45]:
    print(f'  {b[0][:4]} {b[1]!r} (from {b[2]!r} {b[3]} dob={b[5]}) got={b[4]}')

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Sanctions screening engine.

Matches customer records against a watchlist under the rules in
screening_policy.md: identifier matches, transliteration-tolerant name
equivalence (Arabic / Persian / Cyrillic romanisations, name order,
particles, patronymics, nicknames), strong and weak aliases, company
suffixes, vessel prefixes and date-of-birth corroboration.

Standard library only.  Usage:

    python3 screen.py --watchlist watchlist.json \
                      --customers customers.csv --out decisions.csv
"""

import argparse
import csv
import json
import re
import sys
import unicodedata
from collections import defaultdict

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# text normalisation
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

_TRANS = {
    "ß": "ss", "æ": "ae", "œ": "oe", "ø": "o", "å": "a", "đ": "dj", "ð": "d",
    "þ": "th", "ı": "i", "ł": "l", "ħ": "h", "ʻ": "", "ʼ": "", "’": "",
    "`": "", "´": "", "'": "", "ẚ": "a",
    # turkish / slavic / scientific transliteration letters
    "ş": "sh", "ç": "ch", "ğ": "g", "ü": "u", "ö": "o",
    "š": "sh", "ž": "zh", "č": "ch", "ć": "ch", "ś": "sh", "ź": "zh",
    "ż": "zh", "ř": "rzh", "ľ": "l", "ď": "d", "ť": "t", "ņ": "n",
    "ń": "n", "ñ": "n", "ç": "ch", "ǧ": "gh", "ḥ": "h", "ḫ": "kh",
    "ẖ": "kh", "ṣ": "s", "ḍ": "d", "ṭ": "t", "ẓ": "z", "ʿ": "", "ʾ": "",
    "ġ": "gh", "ǎ": "a", "ě": "ye", "ō": "o", "ū": "u", "ī": "i",
    "ā": "a", "ē": "e", "ŷ": "y", "ǰ": "zh", "ĵ": "zh",
}


def fold(s):
    """Lower-case, expand special letters, drop combining marks."""
    s = unicodedata.normalize("NFC", s).lower()
    out = []
    for ch in s:
        if ch in _TRANS:
            out.append(_TRANS[ch])
        else:
            out.append(ch)
    s = "".join(out)
    s = unicodedata.normalize("NFD", s)
    s = "".join(c for c in s if not unicodedata.combining(c))
    return s


def is_cyrillic(s):
    return any(0x0400 <= ord(c) <= 0x04FF for c in s)


def is_arabic(s):
    return any(0x0600 <= ord(c) <= 0x06FF for c in s)


def is_script(s):
    return is_cyrillic(s) or is_arabic(s)


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# phonetic canonicalisation
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Symbols: consonants b p t d k g f v s z m n l r h y
#          X = sh, J = zh, C = ch, D = dj, Q = gh/q, T? none
#          Z is "ts"  -> use '7'
#          vowels: 'a' front class, 'u' back class (collapsed later)

TS = "7"

VOW = set("aeiouy")

# english names whose final w is a vowel, not the slavic /v/
ENGLISH_W = {"andrew", "matthew", "drew", "bartholomew", "shaw", "crow",
             "snow", "lew", "huw"}

# rules: prefix -> list of emitted options.  Longest prefix wins.
_RULES = [
    ("schtsch", ["X"]),
    ("stsch", ["X"]),
    ("shch", ["X", "XC"]),
    ("szcz", ["X", "XC"]),
    ("tsch", ["C", "X", "h"]),
    ("dsch", ["D"]),
    ("dzh", ["D"]),
    ("sch", ["X", "J", "sC"]),
    ("tch", ["C", "X", "h"]),
    ("tsh", ["C"]),
    ("zsch", ["J"]),
    ("sh", ["X", "J"]),
    ("sz", ["X", "s"]),
    ("sj", ["X", "sy"]),
    ("zh", ["J"]),
    ("cz", ["C", "7"]),
    ("ch", ["C", "h", "X"]),
    ("dt", ["d", "t"]),
    ("kh", ["h", "k"]),
    ("gh", ["Q", "g"]),
    ("ph", ["f"]),
    ("th", ["t", "s", "z"]),
    ("dh", ["d", "z"]),
    ("ck", ["k"]),
    ("cc", ["k"]),
    ("ts", [TS, "ts"]),
    ("tz", [TS]),
    ("dj", ["D"]),
    ("qu", ["k", "kv"]),
    ("qv", ["k", "kv"]),
    ("x", ["ks"]),
    ("q", ["k", "Q"]),
    ("c", ["k", TS, "C", "D"]),
    ("z", ["z", TS]),
    ("s", ["s"]),
    ("g", ["g", "D", "Q"]),
    ("j", ["D", "J", "y"]),
    ("b", ["b"]),
    ("p", ["p"]),
    ("t", ["t"]),
    ("d", ["d"]),
    ("k", ["k"]),
    ("f", ["f"]),
    ("v", ["v"]),
    ("m", ["m"]),
    ("n", ["n"]),
    ("l", ["l"]),
    ("r", ["r"]),
    ("h", ["h"]),

    _RULES_BY_FIRST[_pat[0]].append((_pat, _opt))

    r"|ich|itch|itsch|ko|iy)$")

    """Context sensitive extra readings.

    Scientific transliteration of Cyrillic with the diacritics dropped
    writes s/z/c for s-hacek/z-hacek/c-hacek, but only before a vowel do we
    accept that reading, so that Smith cannot become Schmidt.  German
    romanisation writes intervocalic s for Cyrillic z (Morosowa/Morozova).
    """
    vn = nxt != "" and nxt in "aeiouy"
    vp = prev != "" and prev in "aeiouy"
    # s-hacek / z-hacek survive as plain s / z; accept that reading before a
    # vowel, and before a consonant only inside the word or in a name whose
    # ending looks slavic (Siskin = Shishkin, Nadezda = Nadezhda).
    deep = (not initial) or slavic

        if vn or nxt == "c" or deep:
            out.append("X")
        if (vn and vp) or (slavic and (vn or vp)):
            out.append("z")

    elif pat == "ss":

    elif pat == "z":

            return ("J",)
    elif pat == "ch":

    return ()

    if ch in "ou":

    return "a"

    tok = re.sub(r"(.)\1+", r"\1", tok)      # Rostammi -> Rostami

    def rec(i, acc):
        if len(out) >= CAP:
            return
        if i >= n:
            out.add("".join(acc))

            nxt = tok[i + 1] if i + 1 < n else ""

                    tok[i + 2:i + 3] in ("a", "e", "i", "y"):
                rec(i + 2, acc + ["v"])
            if ch in "ou" and nxt in ("a", "e", "i"):
                rec(i + 1, acc + ["v"])
            rec(i + 1, acc + [_vowel_sym(ch)])
            return
        if ch in "yjiw":
            prev = tok[i - 1] if i else ""
            nxt = tok[i + 1] if i + 1 < n else ""
            if ch == "w":
                if i == n - 1 and tok in ENGLISH_W:
                    rec(i + 1, acc + ["u"])     # Andrew, Matthew
                else:
                    rec(i + 1, acc + ["v"])     # Smirnow, Jakowlew, Anwar
                return
            # y / j
            if nxt in "aeiou":
                rec(i + 1, acc + ["y"])
                if ch == "j":
                    rec(i + 1, acc + ["D"])
                    rec(i + 1, acc + ["J"])
                rec(i + 1, acc + ["a"])     # glide / plain vowel
            else:
                rec(i + 1, acc + ["a"])
                if ch == "j" and not prev:
                    rec(i + 1, acc + ["D"])
            return
        if ch == "h" and i and tok[i - 1] in "aeiouy" and \
                not any(c not in "aeiouy" for c in tok[i + 1:]):
            rec(i + 1, acc + ["h"])         # silent final -h  (Salmah/Salma)
            rec(i + 1, acc)
            return

                        tok[i + len(pat):i + len(pat) + 1] not in \

                return

        res.append(ch)
    s = "".join(res)
    # split into runs
    out = []
    i = 0
    first_vowel = True
    n = len(s)
    variants = [""]
    while i < n:
        if s[i] in "au":

            kinds = set()

    "mahmut": "mahmoud", "davut": "dawud", "yakup": "yaqub",
    "halil": "khalil", "halit": "khalid", "halid": "khalid",
    "riza": "reza", "seyit": "sayyid", "sait": "saeed",
    "abdurrahman": "abdulrahman", "abdurahman": "abdulrahman",
}

# names whose phonetic key must stay distinct even though the generic
# rules would merge them are not needed here; the table above only adds.

_tokcache = {}


def token_keys(tok):
    """Phonetic key set for a name token, including nickname expansion.

    The nickname table is looked up on the literal spelling (not on the
    phonetic key) so that unrelated names which happen to share a key
    (Sam/Sami, Kit/Kate) cannot chain into each other.
    """
    if tok in _tokcache:
        return _tokcache[tok]
    keys = set(phon(tok))
    roots = NICK.get(tok)
    if roots:
        if not isinstance(roots, tuple):
            roots = (roots,)
        for r in roots:
            keys |= phon(r)
            r2 = NICK.get(r)
            if r2 and not isinstance(r2, tuple):
                keys |= phon(r2)
            elif r2:
                for x in r2:
                    keys |= phon(x)
    _tokcache[tok] = keys
    return keys

def split_tokens(name):
    name = fold(name)
    name = name.replace("&", " and ")
    # L.L.C. -> llc , G.m.b.H. -> gmbh , M/V -> mv
    name = re.sub(r"(?:[a-z]\.){2,}",
                  lambda m: m.group(0).replace(".", ""), name)
    name = re.sub(r"(?<=[a-z])/(?=[a-z])", "", name)
    name = re.sub(r"(?<=[a-z])-(?=[a-z])", "", name)   # al-Douri, Smith-Jones
    name = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9Ѐ-ӿ؀-ۿ]+", " ", name)
    return [t for t in name.split() if t]


def strip_article(tok):
    """Variants of a token with a leading arabic article removed."""
    out = {tok}
    if len(tok) > 4 and tok[0] in "aeiu" and tok[1] == "l":
        out.add(tok[2:])                       # al-/el-/ul- + name
    # sun-letter assimilation: ar-rashid -> arrashid, an-najjar -> annajjar
    if len(tok) > 4 and tok[0] in "ae":
        for c in ("sh", "th", "l", "r", "n", "s", "d", "t", "z"):
            rest = tok[1 + len(c):]
            if tok[1:].startswith(c) and rest.startswith(c) and len(rest) >= 3:
                out.add(rest)
                break
    # mac / mc prefixes are interchangeable
    if tok.startswith("mc") and len(tok) > 3:
        out.add("mac" + tok[2:])
    elif tok.startswith("mac") and len(tok) > 4:
        out.add("mc" + tok[3:])
    return out


class Tok(object):
    __slots__ = ("keys", "kind", "raw")

    def __init__(self, keys, kind, raw):
        self.keys = keys
        self.kind = kind          # core | patro | nasab | initial
        self.raw = raw


PATRO_RE = re.compile(
    r".*(ovich|ovitch|ovitsch|owitsch|owich|ovic|ovych|evich|evitch|evitsch"
    r"|ewitsch|ewich|evic|evych|ievich|jevic|yevich|ich|itch|itsch"
    r"|ovna|owna|evna|ewna|jevna|ievna|yevna|icz|ovitz|evitz)$")

PATRO_STRONG = re.compile(
    r".*(?:(?:ov|ev|iv|yv|ow|ew|off|eff|av)"
    r"(?:ich|itch|itsch|isch|ic|itz|ych|yc|na|nna)"
    r"|ogly|oglu|kyzy|qizi)$")


def _keys_for(tok):
    keys = set()
    for v in strip_article(tok):
        keys |= token_keys(v)
    return keys


def parse_person(name):
    """Return a list of Tok for an individual name."""
    toks = split_tokens(name)
    toks = [t for t in toks if t not in TITLES or len(toks) <= 2]
    if not toks:
        return []
    # trailing western particles attach to the first token
    trailing = []
    while len(toks) > 1 and toks[-1] in WEST_PARTICLES:
        trailing.insert(0, toks.pop())
    head = None
    if trailing:
        head = toks[0]
        toks[0] = "".join(trailing) + toks[0]
    # merge leading western particles onto the following token
    merged = []
    bare = {}
    if head is not None:
        bare[toks[0]] = head
    i = 0
    while i < len(toks):
        t = toks[i]
        if t in WEST_PARTICLES and i + 1 < len(toks):
            j = i
            pref = []
            while j < len(toks) - 1 and toks[j] in WEST_PARTICLES:
                pref.append(toks[j])
                j += 1
            glued = "".join(pref) + toks[j]
            merged.append(glued)
            bare[glued] = toks[j]
            i = j + 1
            continue
        merged.append(t)
        i += 1
    toks = merged
    # arabic compounds: abd (al) X  /  nasr allah  /  abu X
    out = []
    i = 0
    while i < len(toks):
        t = toks[i]
        if t in COMPOUND_HEADS and i + 1 < len(toks):
            j = i + 1
            if toks[j] in ARTICLES and j + 1 < len(toks):
                j += 1
            out.append(("abd", toks[j]))
            i = j + 1
            continue
        if t in KUNYA and i + 1 < len(toks):
            out.append(("abu", toks[i + 1]))
            i += 2
            continue
        if t == "nasr" and i + 1 < len(toks) and toks[i + 1] in (
                "allah", "alah", "ullah", "ollah", "lah"):
            out.append((None, "nasrallah"))
            i += 2
            continue
        if t.startswith("abd") and len(t) > 5:
            out.append(("abd", t[3:]))
            i += 1
            continue
        out.append((None, t))
        i += 1
    # classify
    res = []
    n = len(out)
    idx = 0
    skip_next = 0
    for idx in range(n):
        if skip_next:
            skip_next -= 1
            continue
        pre, t = out[idx]
        if pre is None and t in ARTICLES:
            continue
        if pre is None and t in NASAB and idx + 1 < n and idx > 0:
            # father's name follows (possibly behind an article)
            j = idx + 1
            if out[j][0] is None and out[j][1] in ARTICLES and j + 1 < n:
                j += 1
            core_left = sum(1 for k, (p, x) in enumerate(out)
                            if k not in range(idx, j + 1) and not (
                                p is None and (x in ARTICLES or len(x) == 1)))
            if core_left >= 2:
                p2, t2 = out[j]
                res.append(Tok(_compound_keys(p2, t2), "nasab", t2))
                skip_next = j - idx
                continue
        if pre is None and len(t) == 1:
            res.append(Tok(set(), "initial", t))
            continue
        kind = "core"
        if pre is None and PATRO_STRONG.match(t) and len(t) > 6:
            kind = "patro"
        keys = _compound_keys(pre, t)
        if t in bare:               # van der Berg ~ Berg
            keys = keys | _compound_keys(pre, bare[t])
        res.append(Tok(keys, kind, t))
    # a name consisting only of a patronymic-looking token keeps it as core
    if not [r for r in res if r.kind == "core"]:
        for r in res:
            if r.kind == "patro":
                r.kind = "core"
    return res


ALLAH_RE = re.compile(r"^[aeiou]*l+[aeiou]*h?[ei]?$")


def _tail_variants(t):
    """Candidate spellings for the second half of an arabic compound."""
    out = {t}
    if ALLAH_RE.match(t) and len(t) > 2:
        return {"allah"}
    s = t.lstrip("aeiou")
    if s != t and len(s) >= 3:
        out.add(s)
        for c in ("sh", "l", "r", "n", "s", "d", "t", "z"):
            if s.startswith(c):
                rest = s[len(c):]
                if len(rest) >= 3:
                    out.add(rest)
                break
    return out


def _compound_keys(pre, t):
    if pre is None:
        return _keys_for(t)
    base = set()
    for v in _tail_variants(t):
        base |= _keys_for(v)
    return set(pre + "|" + k for k in base)


def parse_org(name, vessel=False):
    toks = split_tokens(name)
    if vessel:
        while toks and toks[0] in VESSEL_PREFIX:
            toks.pop(0)
        return [t for t in toks if t]
    out = []
    for t in toks:
        if t in ("and",):
            continue
        if out and out[-1] in ("al", "el", "ul") :
            out[-1] = out[-1] + t          # "Al Noor" == "Al-Noor"
            continue
        out.append(t)
    while out and out[0] == "the":
        out.pop(0)
    # drop legal designators (multiword first)
    joined = " ".join(out)
    changed = True
    while changed:
        changed = False
        for lg in LEGAL:
            if " " in lg:
                if joined.endswith(" " + lg):
                    joined = joined[: -(len(lg) + 1)]
                    changed = True
                elif joined.startswith(lg + " "):
                    joined = joined[len(lg) + 1:]
                    changed = True
    out = [t for t in joined.split() if t]
    while out and out[-1] in LEGAL_SET:
        out.pop()
    while out and out[0] in LEGAL_SET and len(out) > 1:
        out.pop(0)
    return out

    "ж": "zh", "з": "z", "и": "i", "й": "y", "к": "k", "л": "l", "м": "m",

    "і": "i", "ї": "yi", "є": "ye", "ґ": "g", "ў": "u",

def translit_script(tok):
    out = []
    for ch in tok:
        if ch in CY_MAP:
            out.append(CY_MAP[ch])
        elif ch in AR_MAP:
            out.append(AR_MAP[ch])
        elif ch.isalnum():
            out.append(ch)
    return "".join(out)


def merge_script_tokens(toks):
    out = []
    i = 0
    while i < len(toks):
        if toks[i] in ("عبد", "نصر") and i + 1 < len(toks):
            out.append(toks[i] + " " + toks[i + 1])
            i += 2
        else:
            out.append(toks[i])
            i += 1
    return out


class ScriptLex(object):
    """script token -> latin spelling, learnt from the watchlist itself."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.m = {}

    @staticmethod
    def _latin_units(pn):
        """Group a latin name the same way script names group (abd X)."""
        toks = pn.split()
        out = []
        i = 0
        while i < len(toks):
            t = fold(toks[i]).strip("-")
            if (t in COMPOUND_HEADS or (t.startswith("abd") and len(t) <= 5)) \
                    and i + 1 < len(toks):
                j = i + 1
                if fold(toks[j]).strip("-") in ARTICLES and j + 1 < len(toks):
                    j += 1
                out.append(" ".join(toks[i:j + 1]))
                i = j + 1
                continue
            if t == "nasr" and i + 1 < len(toks):
                out.append(" ".join(toks[i:i + 2]))
                i += 2
                continue
            out.append(toks[i])
            i += 1
        return out

    def learn(self, entries):
        votes = defaultdict(lambda: defaultdict(int))
        for e in entries:
            sn = e.get("script_name")
            pn = e.get("primary_name")
            if not sn or not pn or pn == sn or is_script(pn):
                continue
            a = self._latin_units(pn)
            b = merge_script_tokens(sn.split())
            if len(a) != len(b):
                continue
            for x, y in zip(b, a):
                votes[x][y.lower()] += 1
        for k, v in votes.items():
            self.m[k] = max(v.items(), key=lambda kv: kv[1])[0]

    def latin(self, script_name):
        """Convert a whole script name into a latin name string."""
        toks = merge_script_tokens(script_name.split())
        out = []
        for t in toks:
            if t in self.m:
                out.append(self.m[t])
            elif " " in t:
                parts = t.split()
                head = parts[0]
                rest = " ".join(parts[1:])
                if head == "عبد":
                    tail = self.m.get(rest) or translit_script(rest)
                    out.append("abdul " + tail)
                elif head == "نصر":
                    out.append("nasrallah")
                else:
                    out.append(translit_script(t.replace(" ", "")))
            else:
                # feminine cyrillic forms of a known masculine surname
                done = False
                if is_cyrillic(t) and t.endswith("а") and t[:-1] in self.m:
                    out.append(self.m[t[:-1]] + "a")
                    done = True
                if not done:
                    out.append(translit_script(t))
        return " ".join(out)

def _demote(key):
    """Turn a key into its non word-initial form (first vowel class -> '.')."""
    for i, ch in enumerate(key):
        if ch in "AU":
            return key[:i] + "." + key[i + 1:]
    return key


def glue(ka, kb, cap=240):
    """Keys for two tokens written as one word (Smith Jones/Smith-Jones)."""
    out = set()
    for a in ka:
        if "|" in a:
            continue
        for b in kb:
            if "|" in b:
                continue
            out.add(a + _demote(b))
            if len(out) >= cap:
                return out
    return out


def _bipartite(cs, es):
    """Maximum matching size between two lists of key-sets (tiny lists)."""
    n, m = len(cs), len(es)
    if not n or not m:
        return 0
    adj = [[j for j in range(m) if cs[i] & es[j]] for i in range(n)]
    matchR = [-1] * m

    def try_k(i, seen):
        for j in adj[i]:
            if seen[j]:
                continue
            seen[j] = True
            if matchR[j] == -1 or try_k(matchR[j], seen):
                matchR[j] = i
                return True
        return False

    cnt = 0
    for i in range(n):
        if try_k(i, [False] * m):
            cnt += 1
    return cnt


def _merge_variants(keysets, raws):
    """Yield alternative groupings where two tokens are glued together."""
    yield keysets
    n = len(keysets)
    if n < 2 or n > 4:
        return
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(n):
            if i == j:
                continue
            glued = glue(keysets[i], keysets[j])
            if not glued:
                continue
            rest = [keysets[k] for k in range(n) if k not in (i, j)]
            yield rest + [glued]


def person_match(ctoks, etoks):
    """True when two parsed individual names refer to the same person."""
    ccore = [t.keys for t in ctoks if t.kind == "core"]
    ecore = [t.keys for t in etoks if t.kind == "core"]
    if len(ccore) < 2 or len(ecore) < 2:
        return False
    # patronymic / nasab consistency
    cp = [t.keys for t in ctoks if t.kind == "patro"]
    ep = [t.keys for t in etoks if t.kind == "patro"]
    if cp and ep and not any(a & b for a in cp for b in ep):
        return False
    cn = [t.keys for t in ctoks if t.kind == "nasab"]
    en = [t.keys for t in etoks if t.kind == "nasab"]
    if cn and en and not any(a & b for a in cn for b in en):
        return False
    best = False
    for cv in _merge_variants(ccore, None):
        for ev in _merge_variants(ecore, None):
            m = _bipartite(cv, ev)
            if m < 2:
                continue
            if (len(cv) - m) + (len(ev) - m) <= 1:
                best = True
                break
        if best:
            break
    if not best:
        return False
    return True


def alias_equal(ctoks, etoks):
    """Strict equality used for weak aliases."""
    c = [t.keys for t in ctoks if t.kind in ("core", "nasab", "patro")]
    e = [t.keys for t in etoks if t.kind in ("core", "nasab", "patro")]
    if len(c) != len(e) or not c:
        return False
    return _bipartite(c, e) == len(c)


def org_match(cwords, ewords):
    if not cwords or not ewords:
        return False
    if len(cwords) != len(ewords):
        return False
    return all(a == b for a, b in zip(cwords, ewords))

def parse_dob(s):
    s = (s or "").strip()
    if not s:
        return None
    m = re.match(r"^(\d{4})(?:-(\d{1,2}))?(?:-(\d{1,2}))?$", s)
    if not m:
        m2 = re.match(r"^(\d{4})$", s[:4])
        if not m2:
            return None
        return (s[:4],)
    parts = [m.group(1)]
    if m.group(2):
        parts.append("%02d" % int(m.group(2)))
    if m.group(3):
        parts.append("%02d" % int(m.group(3)))
    return tuple(parts)


def dob_compatible(c, e):
    """(compatible, corroborated)"""
    if not c or not e:
        return True, False
    n = min(len(c), len(e))
    for i in range(n):
        if c[i] != e[i]:
            return False, False
    return True, True

class Form(object):
    __slots__ = ("toks", "words", "strong")

    def __init__(self, toks, words, strong):
        self.toks = toks
        self.words = words
        self.strong = strong


class Entry(object):
    __slots__ = ("uid", "type", "dob", "forms", "weak", "ids", "weakforms")

    def __init__(self, uid, typ, dob):
        self.uid = uid
        self.type = typ
        self.dob = dob
        self.forms = []
        self.weak = []
        self.weakforms = []
        self.ids = []


def build_entries(raw, lex):
    entries = []
    for e in raw:
        typ = e.get("type") or "individual"
        ent = Entry(e["uid"], typ, parse_dob(e.get("dob")))
        names = []
        pn = e.get("primary_name") or ""
        sn = e.get("script_name") or ""
        if pn:
            names.append(pn)
        if sn:
            names.append(lex.latin(sn))
        for a in e.get("aliases") or []:
            nm = a.get("name") or ""
            if not nm:
                continue
            if is_script(nm):
                nm = lex.latin(nm)
            if (a.get("strength") or "strong").lower() == "weak":
                ent.weak.append(nm)
            else:
                names.append(nm)
        seen = set()
        for nm in names:
            if is_script(nm):
                nm = lex.latin(nm)
            key = fold(nm)
            if key in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(key)
            if typ == "individual":
                ent.forms.append(Form(parse_person(nm), None, True))
            else:
                ent.forms.append(Form(None, parse_org(nm, typ == "vessel"),
                                      True))
        ent.weakforms = [parse_person(n) if typ == "individual" else None
                         for n in ent.weak]
        for i in e.get("ids") or []:
            t = (i.get("type") or "").strip().lower()
            num = re.sub(r"[^A-Z0-9]", "", (i.get("number") or "").upper())
            if num:
                ent.ids.append((t, num))
        entries.append(ent)
    return entries


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# main screening
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

def build_index(entries):
    idx = defaultdict(set)
    for ent in entries:
        for f in ent.forms:
            if f.toks is not None:
                units = []
                for t in f.toks:
                    if t.kind in ("core", "nasab"):
                        units.append(t.keys)
                allk = set()
                for u in units:
                    allk |= u
                # glued pairs (hyphenated surnames written apart)
                core = [t.keys for t in f.toks if t.kind == "core"]
                if 2 <= len(core) <= 4:
                    for i in range(len(core)):
                        for j in range(len(core)):
                            if i != j:

                    idx[k].add(ent.uid)
            else:
                for w in f.words:

    return idx


def weak_index(entries):
    idx = defaultdict(set)
    for ent in entries:
        for ftoks in ent.weakforms:
            if not ftoks:
                continue
            for t in ftoks:
                for k in t.keys:
                    idx[k].add(ent.uid)
    return idx


def id_index(entries):
    idx = defaultdict(set)
    for ent in entries:
        for t, num in ent.ids:
            idx[(t, num)].add(ent.uid)
            idx[(None, num)].add(ent.uid)
    return idx


def screen(customers, entries, lex):
    by_uid = {e.uid: e for e in entries}
    idx = build_index(entries)
    widx = weak_index(entries)
    iidx = id_index(entries)
    results = []
    for c in customers:
        cid = c.get("customer_id") or ""
        name = (c.get("full_name") or "").strip()
        typ = (c.get("type") or "individual").strip().lower() or "individual"
        dob = parse_dob(c.get("dob"))
        idt = (c.get("id_type") or "").strip().lower()
        idn = re.sub(r"[^A-Z0-9]", "", (c.get("id_number") or "").upper())
        decision = "NO_MATCH"
        uid = ""
        # ---- rule 1: identifiers ------------------------------------
        if idn:
            hits = iidx.get((idt, idn)) if idt else iidx.get((None, idn))
            if hits:
                uid = sorted(hits)[0]
                results.append((cid, "MATCH", uid))
                continue
        # ---- rule 2/5: names ----------------------------------------
        if is_script(name):
            name = lex.latin(name)
        cands = set()
        if typ == "individual":
            ctoks = parse_person(name)
            units = [t.keys for t in ctoks if t.kind in ("core", "nasab")]
            core = [t.keys for t in ctoks if t.kind == "core"]
            keysets = list(units)
            if 2 <= len(core) <= 4:
                glued = set()
                for i in range(len(core)):
                    for j in range(len(core)):
                        if i != j:
                            glued |= glue(core[i], core[j], 120)
                if glued:
                    keysets.append(glued)
            hit = defaultdict(int)
            for ks in keysets:
                seen = set()
                for k in ks:
                    for u in idx.get(k, ()):
                        seen.add(u)
                for u in seen:
                    hit[u] += 1
            cands = {u for u, n in hit.items() if n >= 2}
        else:
            words = parse_org(name, typ == "vessel")
            if words:
                sets = [idx.get("W:" + w, set()) for w in words]
                cands = set.intersection(*sets) if sets else set()
        # evaluate candidates
        strong_hits = []
        for u in cands:
            ent = by_uid[u]
            if ent.type != typ:
                continue
            ok = False
            for f in ent.forms:
                if typ == "individual":
                    if person_match(ctoks, f.toks):
                        ok = True
                        break
                else:
                    if org_match(words, f.words):
                        ok = True
                        break
            if not ok:
                continue
            comp, corr = dob_compatible(dob, ent.dob)
            if not comp:
                continue
            strong_hits.append((0 if corr else 1, u))
        # ---- rule 3: weak aliases -----------------------------------
        if not strong_hits and typ == "individual" and dob and len(dob) == 3:
            wc = set()
            hit = defaultdict(int)
            for t in ctoks:
                if t.kind not in ("core", "nasab"):
                    continue
                seen = set()
                for k in t.keys:
                    for u in widx.get(k, ()):
                        seen.add(u)
                for u in seen:
                    hit[u] += 1
            for u, n in hit.items():
                ent = by_uid[u]
                if ent.type != typ or not ent.dob or len(ent.dob) != 3:
                    continue
                if ent.dob != dob:
                    continue
                for wf in ent.weakforms:
                    if wf and alias_equal(ctoks, wf):
                        strong_hits.append((0, u))
                        break
        if strong_hits:
            strong_hits.sort(key=lambda x: (x[0], x[1]))
            decision = "MATCH"
            uid = strong_hits[0][1]
        results.append((cid, decision, uid))
    return results


def main(argv=None):
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--watchlist", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--customers", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--out", required=True)
    args = ap.parse_args(argv)

    with open(args.watchlist, "r", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        raw = json.load(fh)
    lex = ScriptLex()
    lex.learn(raw)
    entries = build_entries(raw, lex)
    with open(args.customers, "r", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        customers = list(csv.DictReader(fh))
    rows = screen(customers, entries, lex)
    with open(args.out, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as fh:
        w = csv.writer(fh)
        w.writerow(["customer_id", "decision", "matched_uid"])
        for r in rows:
            w.writerow(r)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Sanctions screening engine.

Matches customer records against a watchlist under the rules in
screening_policy.md: identifier matches, transliteration-tolerant name
equivalence (Arabic / Persian / Cyrillic romanisations, name order,
particles, patronymics, nicknames), strong and weak aliases, company
suffixes, vessel prefixes and date-of-birth corroboration.

Standard library only.  Usage:

    python3 screen.py --watchlist watchlist.json \
                      --customers customers.csv --out decisions.csv
"""

import json

import unicodedata
from collections import defaultdict

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# text normalisation
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

_TRANS = {
    "ß": "ss", "æ": "ae", "œ": "oe", "ø": "o", "å": "a", "đ": "dj", "ð": "d",
    "þ": "th", "ı": "i", "ł": "l", "ħ": "h", "ʻ": "", "ʼ": "", "’": "",
    "`": "", "´": "", "'": "", "ẚ": "a",
    # turkish / slavic / scientific transliteration letters
    "ş": "sh", "ç": "ch", "ğ": "g", "ü": "u", "ö": "o",
    "š": "sh", "ž": "zh", "č": "ch", "ć": "ch", "ś": "sh", "ź": "zh",
    "ż": "zh", "ř": "rzh", "ľ": "l", "ď": "d", "ť": "t", "ņ": "n",
    "ń": "n", "ñ": "n", "ç": "ch", "ǧ": "gh", "ḥ": "h", "ḫ": "kh",
    "ẖ": "kh", "ṣ": "s", "ḍ": "d", "ṭ": "t", "ẓ": "z", "ʿ": "", "ʾ": "",
    "ġ": "gh", "ǎ": "a", "ě": "ye", "ō": "o", "ū": "u", "ī": "i",
    "ā": "a", "ē": "e", "ŷ": "y", "ǰ": "zh", "ĵ": "zh",
}


def fold(s):
    """Lower-case, expand special letters, drop combining marks."""
    s = unicodedata.normalize("NFC", s).lower()
    out = []
    for ch in s:
        if ch in _TRANS:
            out.append(_TRANS[ch])
        else:
            out.append(ch)
    s = "".join(out)
    s = unicodedata.normalize("NFD", s)
    s = "".join(c for c in s if not unicodedata.combining(c))
    return s


def is_cyrillic(s):
    return any(0x0400 <= ord(c) <= 0x04FF for c in s)


def is_arabic(s):
    return any(0x0600 <= ord(c) <= 0x06FF for c in s)


def is_script(s):
    return is_cyrillic(s) or is_arabic(s)

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Symbols: consonants b p t d k g f v s z m n l r h y
#          X = sh, J = zh, C = ch, D = dj, Q = gh/q, T? none
#          Z is "ts"  -> use '7'
#          vowels: 'a' front class, 'u' back class (collapsed later)

TS = "7"

VOW = set("aeiouy")

# english names whose final w is a vowel, not the slavic /v/

             "snow", "lew", "huw"}

_RULES = [
    ("schtsch", ["X"]),
    ("stsch", ["X"]),
    ("shch", ["X", "XC"]),
    ("szcz", ["X", "XC"]),

    ("sz", ["X", "s"]),

    ("zh", ["J"]),

    ("kh", ["h", "k"]),

    ("th", ["t", "s", "z"]),

    accept that reading, so that Smith cannot become Schmidt.  German
    romanisation writes intervocalic s for Cyrillic z (Morosowa/Morozova).

    # vowel, and before a consonant only inside the word or in a name whose
    # ending looks slavic (Siskin = Shishkin, Nadezda = Nadezhda).

    elif pat == "ss":

    elif pat == "z":

    elif pat == "ch":

    return ()

    if ch in "ou":

    tok = re.sub(r"(.)\1+", r"\1", tok)      # Rostammi -> Rostami
    n = len(tok)

    def rec(i, acc):
        if len(out) >= CAP:

        if i >= n:

                    tok[i + 2:i + 3] in ("a", "e", "i", "y"):

            if ch in "ou" and nxt in ("a", "e", "i"):
                rec(i + 1, acc + ["v"])
            rec(i + 1, acc + [_vowel_sym(ch)])
            return
        if ch in "yjiw":
            prev = tok[i - 1] if i else ""
            nxt = tok[i + 1] if i + 1 < n else ""

                    rec(i + 1, acc + ["u"])     # Andrew, Matthew
                else:
                    rec(i + 1, acc + ["v"])     # Smirnow, Jakowlew, Anwar
                return
            # y / j
            if nxt in "aeiou":
                rec(i + 1, acc + ["y"])
                if ch == "j":

# names whose phonetic key must stay distinct even though the generic
# rules would merge them are not needed here; the table above only adds.

_tokcache = {}


def token_keys(tok):
    """Phonetic key set for a name token, including nickname expansion.

    The nickname table is looked up on the literal spelling (not on the
    phonetic key) so that unrelated names which happen to share a key
    (Sam/Sami, Kit/Kate) cannot chain into each other.
    """
    if tok in _tokcache:
        return _tokcache[tok]
    keys = set(phon(tok))
    roots = NICK.get(tok)
    if roots:
        if not isinstance(roots, tuple):
            roots = (roots,)
        for r in roots:
            keys |= phon(r)
            r2 = NICK.get(r)
            if r2 and not isinstance(r2, tuple):
                keys |= phon(r2)
            elif r2:
                for x in r2:
                    keys |= phon(x)
    _tokcache[tok] = keys
    return keys

def split_tokens(name):
    name = fold(name)
    name = name.replace("&", " and ")
    # L.L.C. -> llc , G.m.b.H. -> gmbh , M/V -> mv
    name = re.sub(r"(?:[a-z]\.){2,}",
                  lambda m: m.group(0).replace(".", ""), name)
    name = re.sub(r"(?<=[a-z])/(?=[a-z])", "", name)
    name = re.sub(r"(?<=[a-z])-(?=[a-z])", "", name)   # al-Douri, Smith-Jones
    name = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9Ѐ-ӿ؀-ۿ]+", " ", name)
    return [t for t in name.split() if t]


def strip_article(tok):
    """Variants of a token with a leading arabic article removed."""
    out = {tok}
    if len(tok) > 4 and tok[0] in "aeiu" and tok[1] == "l":
        out.add(tok[2:])                       # al-/el-/ul- + name
    # sun-letter assimilation: ar-rashid -> arrashid, an-najjar -> annajjar
    if len(tok) > 4 and tok[0] in "ae":
        for c in ("sh", "th", "l", "r", "n", "s", "d", "t", "z"):
            rest = tok[1 + len(c):]
            if tok[1:].startswith(c) and rest.startswith(c) and len(rest) >= 3:
                out.add(rest)
                break
    # mac / mc prefixes are interchangeable
    if tok.startswith("mc") and len(tok) > 3:
        out.add("mac" + tok[2:])
    elif tok.startswith("mac") and len(tok) > 4:
        out.add("mc" + tok[3:])
    return out


class Tok(object):
    __slots__ = ("keys", "kind", "raw")

    def __init__(self, keys, kind, raw):
        self.keys = keys
        self.kind = kind          # core | patro | nasab | initial
        self.raw = raw


PATRO_RE = re.compile(
    r".*(ovich|ovitch|ovitsch|owitsch|owich|ovic|ovych|evich|evitch|evitsch"
    r"|ewitsch|ewich|evic|evych|ievich|jevic|yevich|ich|itch|itsch"
    r"|ovna|owna|evna|ewna|jevna|ievna|yevna|icz|ovitz|evitz)$")

PATRO_STRONG = re.compile(
    r".*(?:(?:ov|ev|iv|yv|ow|ew|off|eff|av)"
    r"(?:ich|itch|itsch|isch|ic|itz|ych|yc|na|nna)"
    r"|ogly|oglu|kyzy|qizi)$")


def _keys_for(tok):
    keys = set()
    for v in strip_article(tok):
        keys |= token_keys(v)
    return keys


def parse_person(name):
    """Return a list of Tok for an individual name."""
    toks = split_tokens(name)
    toks = [t for t in toks if t not in TITLES or len(toks) <= 2]
    if not toks:
        return []
    # trailing western particles attach to the first token
    trailing = []
    while len(toks) > 1 and toks[-1] in WEST_PARTICLES:
        trailing.insert(0, toks.pop())
    head = None
    if trailing:
        head = toks[0]
        toks[0] = "".join(trailing) + toks[0]
    # merge leading western particles onto the following token
    merged = []
    bare = {}
    if head is not None:
        bare[toks[0]] = head
    i = 0
    while i < len(toks):
        t = toks[i]
        if t in WEST_PARTICLES and i + 1 < len(toks):
            j = i
            pref = []
            while j < len(toks) - 1 and toks[j] in WEST_PARTICLES:
                pref.append(toks[j])
                j += 1
            glued = "".join(pref) + toks[j]
            merged.append(glued)
            bare[glued] = toks[j]
            i = j + 1
            continue
        merged.append(t)
        i += 1
    toks = merged
    # arabic compounds: abd (al) X  /  nasr allah  /  abu X
    out = []
    i = 0
    while i < len(toks):
        t = toks[i]
        if t in COMPOUND_HEADS and i + 1 < len(toks):
            j = i + 1
            if toks[j] in ARTICLES and j + 1 < len(toks):
                j += 1
            out.append(("abd", toks[j]))
            i = j + 1
            continue
        if t in KUNYA and i + 1 < len(toks):
            out.append(("abu", toks[i + 1]))
            i += 2
            continue
        if t == "nasr" and i + 1 < len(toks) and toks[i + 1] in (
                "allah", "alah", "ullah", "ollah", "lah"):
            out.append((None, "nasrallah"))
            i += 2
            continue
        if t.startswith("abd") and len(t) > 5:
            out.append(("abd", t[3:]))
            i += 1
            continue
        out.append((None, t))
        i += 1
    # classify
    res = []
    n = len(out)
    idx = 0
    skip_next = 0
    for idx in range(n):
        if skip_next:
            skip_next -= 1
            continue
        pre, t = out[idx]
        if pre is None and t in ARTICLES:
            continue
        if pre is None and t in NASAB and idx + 1 < n and idx > 0:
            # father's name follows (possibly behind an article)
            j = idx + 1
            if out[j][0] is None and out[j][1] in ARTICLES and j + 1 < n:
                j += 1
            core_left = sum(1 for k, (p, x) in enumerate(out)
                            if k not in range(idx, j + 1) and not (
                                p is None and (x in ARTICLES or len(x) == 1)))
            if core_left >= 2:
                p2, t2 = out[j]
                res.append(Tok(_compound_keys(p2, t2), "nasab", t2))
                skip_next = j - idx
                continue
        if pre is None and len(t) == 1:
            res.append(Tok(set(), "initial", t))
            continue
        kind = "core"
        if pre is None and PATRO_STRONG.match(t) and len(t) > 6:
            kind = "patro"
        keys = _compound_keys(pre, t)
        if t in bare:               # van der Berg ~ Berg
            keys = keys | _compound_keys(pre, bare[t])
        res.append(Tok(keys, kind, t))
    # a patronymic is only droppable when a given name and a family name
    # remain; otherwise it is the family name (Popovic, Ivanovich)
    ncore = sum(1 for r in res if r.kind == "core")
    if ncore < 2:
        for r in res:
            if r.kind == "patro" and ncore < 2:
                r.kind = "core"
                ncore += 1
    return res


ALLAH_RE = re.compile(r"^[aeiou]*l+[aeiou]*h?[ei]?$")


def _tail_variants(t):
    """Candidate spellings for the second half of an arabic compound."""
    out = {t}
    if ALLAH_RE.match(t) and len(t) > 2:
        return {"allah"}
    s = t.lstrip("aeiou")
    if s != t and len(s) >= 3:
        out.add(s)
        for c in ("sh", "l", "r", "n", "s", "d", "t", "z"):
            if s.startswith(c):
                rest = s[len(c):]
                if len(rest) >= 3:
                    out.add(rest)
                break
    return out


def _compound_keys(pre, t):
    if pre is None:
        return _keys_for(t)
    base = set()
    for v in _tail_variants(t):
        base |= _keys_for(v)
    return set(pre + "|" + k for k in base)


def parse_org(name, vessel=False):
    toks = split_tokens(name)
    if vessel:
        while toks and toks[0] in VESSEL_PREFIX:
            toks.pop(0)
        return [t for t in toks if t]
    out = []
    for t in toks:
        if t in ("and",):
            continue
        if out and out[-1] in ("al", "el", "ul") :
            out[-1] = out[-1] + t          # "Al Noor" == "Al-Noor"
            continue
        out.append(t)
    while out and out[0] == "the":
        out.pop(0)
    # drop legal designators (multiword first)
    joined = " ".join(out)
    changed = True
    while changed:
        changed = False
        for lg in LEGAL:
            if " " in lg:
                if joined.endswith(" " + lg):
                    joined = joined[: -(len(lg) + 1)]
                    changed = True
                elif joined.startswith(lg + " "):
                    joined = joined[len(lg) + 1:]
                    changed = True
    out = [t for t in joined.split() if t]
    while out and out[-1] in LEGAL_SET:
        out.pop()
    while out and out[0] in LEGAL_SET and len(out) > 1:
        out.pop(0)
    return out

def translit_script(tok):
    out = []
    for ch in tok:
        if ch in CY_MAP:
            out.append(CY_MAP[ch])
        elif ch in AR_MAP:
            out.append(AR_MAP[ch])
        elif ch.isalnum():
            out.append(ch)
    return "".join(out)


def merge_script_tokens(toks):
    out = []
    i = 0
    while i < len(toks):
        if toks[i] in ("عبد", "نصر") and i + 1 < len(toks):
            out.append(toks[i] + " " + toks[i + 1])
            i += 2
        else:
            out.append(toks[i])
            i += 1
    return out


class ScriptLex(object):
    """script token -> latin spelling, learnt from the watchlist itself."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.m = {}

    @staticmethod
    def _latin_units(pn):
        """Group a latin name the same way script names group (abd X)."""
        toks = pn.split()
        out = []
        i = 0
        while i < len(toks):
            t = fold(toks[i]).strip("-")
            if (t in COMPOUND_HEADS or (t.startswith("abd") and len(t) <= 5)) \
                    and i + 1 < len(toks):
                j = i + 1
                if fold(toks[j]).strip("-") in ARTICLES and j + 1 < len(toks):
                    j += 1
                out.append(" ".join(toks[i:j + 1]))
                i = j + 1
                continue
            if t == "nasr" and i + 1 < len(toks):
                out.append(" ".join(toks[i:i + 2]))
                i += 2
                continue
            out.append(toks[i])
            i += 1
        return out

    def learn(self, entries):
        votes = defaultdict(lambda: defaultdict(int))
        for e in entries:
            sn = e.get("script_name")
            pn = e.get("primary_name")
            if not sn or not pn or pn == sn or is_script(pn):
                continue
            a = self._latin_units(pn)
            b = merge_script_tokens(sn.split())
            if len(a) != len(b):
                continue
            for x, y in zip(b, a):
                votes[x][y.lower()] += 1
        for k, v in votes.items():
            self.m[k] = max(v.items(), key=lambda kv: kv[1])[0]

    def latin(self, script_name):
        """Convert a whole script name into a latin name string."""
        toks = merge_script_tokens(script_name.split())
        out = []
        for t in toks:
            if t in self.m:
                out.append(self.m[t])
            elif " " in t:
                parts = t.split()
                head = parts[0]
                rest = " ".join(parts[1:])
                if head == "عبد":
                    tail = self.m.get(rest) or translit_script(rest)
                    out.append("abdul " + tail)
                elif head == "نصر":
                    out.append("nasrallah")
                else:
                    out.append(translit_script(t.replace(" ", "")))
            else:
                # feminine cyrillic forms of a known masculine surname
                done = False
                if is_cyrillic(t) and t.endswith("а") and t[:-1] in self.m:
                    out.append(self.m[t[:-1]] + "a")
                    done = True
                if not done:
                    out.append(translit_script(t))
        return " ".join(out)
